acceptance: A nested fixture line in a passed test step never prints as a failure, in any job
Each failureKey of an existing row is unchanged
A table row that a workflow rename makes false fails a test
fix: Design first. One table of each step in the four workflows, and one reader. Delete p.makes, p.steps and p.jobs. Keep each failure key, or an open inbox item gets a duplicate.

intake_override.reason: changes the CI classifier that the console reads at each red

summary: Row 5a reads the failed step of the five coverage gates from the job API. Each other job keeps the text parser, so a nested fixture line can still print as a false test row in a job that failed elsewhere. A gate red on the base also gives pre-existing, also for a refusal in a touched file, because the key is the gate and not the item. The 8 findings of revision 2 of the row 5 design card state what this end state must handle: the job display names of four workflows, test steps outside go.yml, failure keys of make steps, a cancelled step, a job with no failed step, the 55 MB log. The card is in backups/session-2026-11-04/design-card-row5.md.
title: ci classify keeps a second reader of the failed step, for each job that is not one of the five coverage gates
